findings.scope: The default scan covers 16 files with 11 errors and 119 warnings across 13 work units. Production contains 8 files with 5 errors and 44 warnings; tests contain 8 files with 6 errors and 75 warnings. The scoped report and units scan are restricted to crates/engine_scene.
findings.architecture: The scoped report found zero placement, similarity, dependency, cycle, encapsulation, configurable-data, or transitive-navigation findings, with zero architecture extraction errors. Cross-scope caller inspection found the public components and systems consumed by axiom2d, card_game, card_game_bin, demo, engine_audio, engine_render, engine_ui, and terrain_viewer.
findings.reason: The three types-per-file errors are cohesive pairs: ChildOf and Children define one hierarchy contract, RenderLayer and SortOrder define one render-order contract, and Visible and EffectiveVisibility define one visibility contract. Splitting them would widen module paths and require compatibility re-exports without reducing responsibility. The recursive transform and visibility helpers take ECS queries, change trackers, and deferred commands that must share one traversal; wrapping those parameters in ad hoc context structs would add indirection without a clearer ownership seam. The duplicate blocks and long test files are behavior fixtures, not duplicated production ownership, and the wildcard imports and line-length findings are cosmetic. No DELETE, DEDUPE, SPLIT, SIMPLIFY, SIGNATURES, or COSMETIC source change is justified by this evidence.
findings.behaviorEvidence: The focused baseline `cargo test -p engine_scene --locked` passed 54 integration tests with zero failures. The full baseline `cargo test --workspace --locked` passed with zero failures; the only emitted warning was the existing empty terrain TSX asset notice. No UI smoke or hosted runner was used because engine_scene is headless ECS behavior.
findings.replayBlocker: Source-changing committed replay remains blocked solely by dod-guard#621: the bundled quality-guard gate requires the absent `.github/quality/quality-baseline.json` instead of this repository's `docs/QUALITY_BASELINE.ron`. No baseline or documentation file was created or edited.
